pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When do you say "Gute Nacht"? (1 mark)
   A. When you meet in the morning
   B. When you say hello at midday
   C. When you meet a teacher
   D. When someone goes to bed

2. What does "Gute Nacht" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thank you
   B. bye (friendly)
   C. good evening
   D. good night

3. Which sentence is used to say your name? (1 mark)
   A. Wie geht's?
   B. Auf Wiedersehen.
   C. Ich heiße Anna.
   D. Wie heißt du?

4. What does "der Vater" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. brothers and sisters
   B. father
   C. aunt
   D. friend

5. Which noun goes with "meine"? (1 mark)
   A. Vater
   B. Bruder
   C. Onkel
   D. Mutter

6. What does "der Sohn" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. uncle
   B. friend
   C. brother
   D. son

7. Which letter sounds like "ts" in "Zimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. sch
   B. z
   C. ch
   D. w

8. What does "heute" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. today
   B. often
   C. always
   D. now

9. Which two days make up the weekend (das Wochenende)? (1 mark)
   A. Samstag and Sonntag
   B. Montag and Dienstag
   C. Freitag and Samstag
   D. Sonntag and Montag

10. What number is "zwanzig"? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 0
   D. 13

11. What number is "zwölf"? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 3
   C. 12
   D. 6

12. What does "das Ohr" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. finger
   B. tummy
   C. ear
   D. mouth

13. Which song teaches "Kopf, Schulter, Knie und Fuß"? (1 mark)
   A. A song about the weather
   B. A birthday song
   C. A song about days
   D. The action song about body parts

14. What does "Wie ist das Wetter?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. Who is there?
   B. What is the weather like?
   C. Where is the house?
   D. What time is it?

15. What does "kochen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to smell
   B. to cook
   C. to sleep
   D. to dance

16. How is the letter F named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ah
   B. hah
   C. eff
   D. pay

17. What does "Danke" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hello (friendly)
   B. goodbye
   C. thank you
   D. good morning

18. Which little word goes with the noun "Kind"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. der
   C. das
   D. die

19. What does "groß" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tall or big
   B. kind
   C. old
   D. hard-working

20. What does "jung" mean? (1 mark)
   A. small
   B. old
   C. tall
   D. young

21. Which sentence has the verb in second place? (1 mark)
   A. Am Montag ich gehe zur Schule.
   B. Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule.
   C. Zur Schule am Montag ich gehe.
   D. Ich am Montag gehe zur Schule.

22. Which German word is the number 17? (1 mark)
   A. elf
   B. sieben
   C. siebzehn
   D. zwei

23. Which German word is the number 4? (1 mark)
   A. sechs
   B. eins
   C. zehn
   D. vier

24. What does "die Banane" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. meat
   B. cabbage or kale
   C. banana
   D. maize

25. What does "das Gesicht" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. leg
   B. face
   C. head
   D. back

26. What does "kühl" mean? (1 mark)
   A. wet
   B. hot
   C. cool
   D. warm

27. What does "von März bis Mai" mean? (1 mark)
   A. from March to May
   B. from May to March
   C. in March only
   D. after May

28. Which German word or phrase means "good night"? (1 mark)
   A. Sehr gut
   B. Hallo
   C. Gute Nacht
   D. Ja

29. What is the plural of "die Lampe"? (1 mark)
   A. die Lampen
   B. die Lamper
   C. die Lampes
   D. die Lampe

30. Which little word goes with the noun "Badezimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. der
   C. den
   D. das

31. What is the plural of "das Bett"? (1 mark)
   A. die Betts
   B. die Better
   C. die Betten
   D. die Bette

32. What does "riechen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to eat
   B. to play
   C. to help
   D. to smell

33. Which little word goes with the noun "Kohl"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. der
   D. den

34. Which German word or phrase means "egg"? (1 mark)
   A. die Banane
   B. das Mittagessen
   C. der Kakao
   D. das Ei

35. What is the plural of "der Zahn"? (1 mark)
   A. die Zähner
   B. die Zahns
   C. die Zahne
   D. die Zähne

36. Which German word or phrase means "hair"? (1 mark)
   A. das Haar
   B. der Finger
   C. das Auge
   D. der Kopf

37. Which little word goes with the noun "Fuß"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. die
   D. das

38. Which adjective is made from "Wind"? (1 mark)
   A. windich
   B. windlich
   C. windig
   D. winden

39. What does "nass" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hot
   B. cold
   C. foggy
   D. wet

40. What does "vor" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. behind
   B. between
   C. next to
   D. in front of

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear, cloud, cake. (5 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sofa, bathroom, potato, milk, finger. (5 marks)

43. Write the ordinal numbers for first, second and third in German. (3 marks)

44. Write in German: "The sun is shining." (2 marks)

45. Write the plural of Fuß, Zahn and Auge. (3 marks)

46. Write the German words with der, die or das for: birthday, banana, tummy, apple, cheese. (5 marks)

47. Write three sentences in German that say where things are in your room. (3 marks)

48. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back, sugar, child. (5 marks)

49. Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandfather, plate. (2 marks)

50. Write the German words with der, die or das for: table, fridge, kitchen. (3 marks)

51. Write three sentences that say which item is in which room. (3 marks)

52. Say what "Zum Frühstück trinke ich Tee" means in English. (2 marks)

53. Write the German words with der, die or das for: lamp, tomato. (2 marks)

54. Write the German words with their articles for: kitchen, bedroom, garden, living room. (4 marks)

55. Read: "Heute ist Samstag. Vater liest im Wohnzimmer. Mutter kocht in der Küche." Give the gist. (3 marks)

56. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bread, egg, tomato, water. (4 marks)

57. Write these numbers in German: 1, 15, 20. (3 marks)

58. Write these numbers in German: 3, 7, 11. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — When someone goes to bed
   Gute Nacht wishes someone a good night as they go to sleep.

2. D — good night
   Gute Nacht means good night.

3. C — Ich heiße Anna.
   Ich heiße ... means My name is ...

4. B — father
   der Vater means father.

5. D — Mutter
   Mutter is a die word, so we say meine Mutter.

6. D — son
   der Sohn means son.

7. B — z
   German z is pronounced ts.

8. A — today
   heute means today.

9. A — Samstag and Sonntag
   The weekend is Saturday and Sunday.

10. A — 20
   zwanzig is the number 20.

11. C — 12
   zwölf is the number 12.

12. C — ear
   das Ohr means ear.

13. D — The action song about body parts
   The song names head, shoulders, knees and feet.

14. B — What is the weather like?
   das Wetter is the weather.

15. B — to cook
   kochen means to cook.

16. C — eff
   In German the letter F is called eff.

17. C — thank you
   Danke means thank you.

18. C — das
   It is das Kind, so the little word is das.

19. A — tall or big
   groß means tall or big.

20. D — young
   jung is the opposite of alt.

21. B — Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule.
   In German the verb is the second idea in a statement.

22. C — siebzehn
   17 in German is siebzehn.

23. D — vier
   4 in German is vier.

24. C — banana
   die Banane means banana.

25. B — face
   das Gesicht means face.

26. C — cool
   kühl is cool.

27. A — from March to May
   von ... bis means from ... to.

28. C — Gute Nacht
   good night in German is Gute Nacht.

29. A — die Lampen
   The plural of die Lampe is die Lampen.

30. D — das
   It is das Badezimmer, so the little word is das.

31. C — die Betten
   The plural of das Bett is die Betten.

32. D — to smell
   riechen means to smell.

33. C — der
   It is der Kohl, so the little word is der.

34. D — das Ei
   egg in German is das Ei.

35. D — die Zähne
   The plural of der Zahn is die Zähne.

36. A — das Haar
   hair in German is das Haar.

37. A — der
   It is der Fuß, so the little word is der.

38. C — windig
   Wind + -ig gives windig.

39. D — wet
   nass means wet.

40. D — in front of
   vor means in front of.

SECTION B
----
41. (5 marks)
   Answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr, die Wolke, der Kuchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: das Sofa, das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch, der Finger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: der erste, der zweite, der dritte.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Die Sonne scheint.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Die Sonne and 1 mark for scheint.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Füße, die Zähne, die Augen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plural.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Geburtstag, die Banane, der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist an der Wand. Der Tisch ist neben dem Bett. Die Tasche ist unter dem Tisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

48. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken, der Zucker, das Kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Opa, der Teller.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: For breakfast I drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for breakfast, 1 mark for drink tea.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Lampe, die Tomate.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Küche, das Schlafzimmer, der Garten, das Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is Saturday. Father is reading in the living room and Mother is cooking in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three facts.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Brot, das Ei, die Tomate, das Wasser.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: eins, fünfzehn, zwanzig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: drei, sieben, elf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.
